notes: Prism Archive replaces the root playable source with an operator-based constraint puzzle. Pressing a prism applies the active rule (pulse: prism + 4 orthogonal neighbours; beam: full row + column; split: prism + 4 diagonal neighbours) as a linear toggle over GF(2). Each of the 6 lattices is reverse-scrambled from a fully aligned board, so every puzzle is guaranteed solvable; the same tracked press parity powers a non-cheating hint (reveals one prism of a valid solution) and autoSolve. Hint, undo (full stack), reset, and pause are complete. window.__lumenLatticeQA exposes start, startLevel, restart, reset, undo, hint, clickCell, autoSolve, isSolved, and getSnapshot. The prior variant metadata and all earlier run records are preserved; the prior variant is marked superseded-playable.
